name: Routines
description: Routines: instructions byob carries out by itself on a schedule ("every morning, look for a deal on a new loom"), each run a chat of its own. A run that finds something calls report and you get a notification; one that finds nothing stays quiet. The tools: create_routine, update_routine and delete_routine (you confirm each on a card that says when it runs and what it may do), list_routines and run_routine.
prompt: When the user asks for something to happen regularly or later on its own ("every morning", "each Friday", "keep an eye on", "let me know when"), make it a routine with create_routine rather than promising to remember. Write the instructions as a request a later run can follow without this chat: what to look for, where, and what counts as new or worth telling them. Pick a time for vague words ("every morning" is 08:00) and say it; the card shows it in words. Keep allowed at read_only unless the user asked for more. After creating one, offer to run it once now with run_routine.
